ci_failure_root_cause: tests/unit/test_registry_invariants.py: 3 tests manually did `conn = sqlite3.connect(...) if FACTS_DB.exists() else None` instead of using the file's own facts_conn fixture (which skips cleanly when facts.db is absent) - in CI, where facts.db never exists, this silently produced false-positive dangling-alias failures instead of skipping. Fixed in commit e5e93cd (verified locally by hiding data/facts.db to faithfully reproduce CI's environment: skips cleanly; restored, passes fully).

urgent_finding.summary: 288 facts (measure_type='monthly_actuals', compatibility_group='actual_expense') from source_key='federal_monthly_financial_statements' were already loaded in the live data/facts.db from an earlier, incomplete/exploratory run, despite the mission's framing that the extractor had deliberately not been loaded.
urgent_finding.live_contamination_confirmed: For FY2025-26 federal actuals (the one year with no GFS-basis annual data yet, so src/backend/routers/v2/dashboard.py's _preferred_basis() falls back to 'accrual' instead of excluding it), 12 single-month '<label> | July' nodes were confirmed - via a direct query against the running production container on port 8010, bind-mounted to this same data/facts.db - to be silently summed into the federal actuals root total alongside real annual data. Root total dropped from 795,072,121,000 to 724,901,922,000 (the exact July contribution) after removal.
urgent_finding.remediation: scripts/ops/cleanup_stray_mfs_preload.py (dry-run verified safe: isolated single source_document, 22 nodes, zero breakdown_edges referencing them, no other measure_types under the source) removed all 288 facts + their fact_nodes + 22 nodes + the source_document. Idempotent (second --apply run reports already_clean). Backed up via scripts/ops/backup_facts_db.py first (facts-20260804T233110Z.db).
urgent_finding.verified_after: Live production API for FY2025-26 federal actuals no longer contains any '| July' node; task9_sql_integrity_checks.py still reports hard_failures: 0.

full_pytest_suite.note: run before the stray-MFS cleanup; cleanup only removed data unrelated to any existing test's fixtures/assertions

critical_note_on_existing_measure_defini: measure_type='monthly_actuals' already existed in measure_definitions, mapped to compatibility_group='actual_expense' - the SAME additive group as annual GFS/PBS actuals. This mapping is itself unsafe for any future MFS load and must not be reused as-is; Task 3's semantic model defines dedicated MFS measure types in their own compatibility group(s), separate from annual actual_expense.
